src/frame-policy.ts.name: Host frame rule
src/frame-policy.ts.description: Gives the host page a rule that stops napplet frames navigating away from their verified page.

src/gamepad-policy.ts.name: Controller lockout
src/gamepad-policy.ts.description: Blocks napplet frames from using game controllers, HID and USB devices directly.

src/napplet-csp.ts.name: Napplet security policy
src/napplet-csp.ts.description: Builds the content security policy added to a napplet page, blocking direct network use unless the host allows specific sources.

src/napplet-frame-scan.ts.name: Nested frame check
src/napplet-frame-scan.ts.description: Rejects napplet HTML that would open its own frames, embeds or objects inside the sandbox.

src/napplet-head.ts.name: Early head insert
src/napplet-head.ts.description: Places trusted tags at the very top of a napplet page so they take effect before any of the napplet's own content.

src/napplet-srcdoc.ts.name: Page assembly
src/napplet-srcdoc.ts.description: Puts the security policy first and then the window.napplet script into verified napplet HTML, ready for the frame.
